authority: User requests removing apparent-horizon-interior errors from the budget and prioritizing apparent-horizon mass; puncture measurements are not primary acceptance quantities.
evolution_changes: None; continuation still evolves the full puncture domain with original frozen source and parameters.

budget.region: Saved nodes r >= r_AH(t), with r_AH from the existing outgoing-expansion apparent-horizon finder.
budget.RMS: sqrt(sum_exterior(r^2 * dr/dx * C^2) / sum_exterior(r^2 * dr/dx)) for H, M, Theta, Z; no zero filling of excluded nodes.
budget.pointwise: Maximum absolute constraint on the same apparent-horizon exterior.
budget.primary_invariant: Apparent-horizon mass relative to initial Schwarzschild M=1/3; report absolute and relative error.
budget.excluded_from_acceptance: All errors at nodes inside the apparent horizon, including AF/puncture mass estimates; retain as secondary diagnostics.

scope: Prospective interpretation amendment for this single-grid long-duration pilot. Historical full-domain three-grid results and their original assessment remain unchanged. No new numerical pass threshold or convergence claim is inferred.
